text: 1.The Highest Diploma, which should be certified copies in Chinese or English; 2.Certificate of the language proficiency if there is(TOEFL or IELTS); 3.Official academic transcript(certified copies); 4.One photocopy of your valid national passport; 5.Others: kinds of certificates, including sports, arts and other relevant certificates are warmly welcome; 6. Physical Examination form. If you are already in China, the valid visa page is required. ★ All the application materials will not be returned. ★ The application is invalid if the application materials are incomplete.
